target_customer: US adults seeking GLP-1 weight management, cash pay
problem: GLP-1 care is costly and opaque. Gentle Health offers a doctor reviewed online service with transparent pricing and pharmacy shipping.
business_model: Cash-pay subscription: compounded drugs from 135 USD per month or a 28 USD per month care fee for brand-name drugs bought direct (October 2026 listing)

founders.name: Austin Stone
founders.background_notes: YC page says he authored over 20 papers at venues including CVPR and ICML; education not listed

founders.name: Ilariia Belova
education: NTUU KPI (Ukraine), degree in applied mathematics
previous_startups: Tellif AI (founder and CTO, per YC page; outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Led a 12 person ML ads team at Yandex per the YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly telehealth workflow, state licensing and pharmacy integration rather than novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded telehealth category with price competition and no proprietary technology, so copying is easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Brand-name drug makers cut cash prices and launched direct channels, and the FDA moved against mass marketed compounded GLP-1 products in 2026, per press results.

market_need_then: GLP-1 demand was high and cash-pay telehealth boomed in 2025, but branded pricing converged at 499 USD in April 2025 and regulatory pressure on compounding followed.

branding.domain_note: gentle.health, an exact-word name on a .health domain, date unknown

identity.logo: Friendly illustrated mascots per a description of the site
identity.mascot_or_character: Friendly illustrations (site description; not independently viewed)
identity.voice_and_tone: Calm, reassuring, transparent, tagline 'Honest GLP-1 weight management'

brand_strength.rationale: The name and mascot style fit a gentle, trust building tone in a skeptical category, but no external brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Gentle Health is a four person Fall 2025 company in the most crowded and regulation exposed corner of telehealth. It lists transparent cash prices and a doctor led model, but no funding, customer counts or news were found. FDA action on compounded GLP-1 marketing in 2026 is a risk to the compounded side. The outcome is too early to call.
notes: No funding information found in two searches. The competitor entry comes from a search summary of a Sacra note about April 2025 Novo Nordisk partnerships. Mascot detail comes from the site fetch summary only. Founded year not found.
